scope: Focused unmodified RISC-V lat_rpc UDP control; not a native ALL pass
server: unmodified lat_rpc -s; rpcinfo confirmed program 404040 over UDP and TCP

asterinas_full_system.qemu: RISC-V virt, TCG, 4 CPUs, 2 GiB RAM

linux_full_system.qemu: RISC-V virt, rv64, TCG, 4 CPUs, 2 GiB RAM, direct Linux kernel boot
linux_full_system.initramfs: Ubuntu riscv64 busybox-static 1.30.1 plus virtio_blk.ko from matching linux-modules; mounts the private Debian ext2 image

linux_user_mode.qemu: qemu-riscv64 user-mode with isolated Linux network namespace
linux_user_mode.note: This does not exercise a RISC-V guest kernel; the first trial's individual output log was overwritten by the repeat script.

conclusion: The original RISC-V binary completes in Linux full-system QEMU TCG. The Asterinas failure is specific to its guest path, but these controls do not distinguish networking from scheduling or wakeup behavior.
